```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Publication figures: every chunk figure is also written as PDF + 300 dpi PNG to Figures_2026b/sccomp_paired_TNK/.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = c("png", "cairo_pdf"), dpi = 300,
                      fig.path = "../Figures_2026b/sccomp_paired_TNK/",
                      echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "", fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
source("config_colors_2026b.R")
# Fits come from 04c_sccomp_paired_TNK.R (counts from the TME metadata of the October 2026 object).
OUT <- "../Outputs/sccomp_paired_TNK_2026b"
ct <- fread(file.path(OUT, "celltype_paired_models.csv"))
tnk <- fread(file.path(OUT, "tnk_subtypes_paired.csv"))
shares <- fread(file.path(OUT, "tnk_subtype_shares.csv"))
n_tnk <- fread(file.path(OUT, "tnk_cells_per_sample.csv"))
n_pairs <- uniqueN(n_tnk$Patient_nr)
kept <- unique(n_tnk[kept == TRUE, Patient_nr])
dropped <- setdiff(unique(n_tnk$Patient_nr), kept)
floor_p <- 2 / 2^length(kept)

stars <- function(p) cut(p, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1), sprintf("%.3f", p))

# Calls per model on the cell-type level (c_pH0 < 0.05)
calls <- ct[c_pH0 < 0.05, .(n = .N, types = paste(sprintf("%s (%s)", cell_group, ifelse(c_effect > 0, "up", "down")), collapse = ", ")), by = model]
n_call <- function(m) if (m %in% calls$model) calls[model == m, n] else 0L
same_hmc <- setequal(ct[model == "hmc, paired" & c_pH0 < 0.05, cell_group], ct[model == "pathfinder, paired (report)" & c_pH0 < 0.05, cell_group])
tp <- tnk[model == "hmc, paired"][order(c_pH0)]
sig_tnk <- tp[c_pH0 < 0.05]
pooled <- shares[, .(n = sum(count)), by = .(SubTyping, origin)] |> dcast(SubTyping ~ origin, value.var = "n", fill = 0)
sig_tnk <- merge(sig_tnk, pooled, by.x = "cell_group", by.y = "SubTyping")
sig_txt <- if (nrow(sig_tnk)) paste(sprintf("%s (%s, sccomp p %s, Wilcoxon p %s, higher in the tumour in %d of %d pairs; %d cells in normal and %d in tumour samples overall)", sig_tnk$cell_group,
  ifelse(sig_tnk$c_effect > 0, "up in tumour", "down in tumour"), fmt_p(sig_tnk$c_pH0), fmt_p(sig_tnk$wilcox_p), sig_tnk$n_up, sig_tnk$n_pairs,
  sig_tnk$`non-malignant`, sig_tnk$primary),
  collapse = "; ") else "none"
same_way <- tp[wilcox_p <= floor_p * 1.001]  # exact Wilcoxon at its floor = every pair moved the same way, no ties
same_way_txt <- if (nrow(same_way)) paste(sprintf("%s %s in all %d pairs (Wilcoxon p %s, sccomp p %s)", same_way$cell_group,
  ifelse(same_way$median_diff < 0, "lower in the tumour", "higher in the tumour"), same_way$n_pairs, fmt_p(same_way$wilcox_p), fmt_p(same_way$c_pH0)),
  collapse = "; ") else "none"
```

Follow-up to the sccomp report: is the tumour vs adjacent-normal comparison really paired, and which T/NK subtypes change between the normal eye tissue and the primary tumour of the same patient?

# {.tabset}

## Overview

- **sccomp does use the pairing.** A patient random intercept, `~ origin + (1 | Patient_nr)`, gives each patient its own baseline composition, so the origin effect is estimated within patients. The atlas has `r n_pairs` such patients (`r paste(sort(unique(n_tnk$Patient_nr)), collapse = ", ")`), each with one non-malignant and one primary sample; no patient has a primary and a metastasis.
- **Model check.** The report fit used sccomp's default fast approximation (pathfinder). Refitted with full MCMC (hmc), the paired model calls `r n_call("hmc, paired")` cell types at p < 0.05 against `r n_call("pathfinder, paired (report)")` with pathfinder (`r if (same_hmc) "the same cell types" else "not the same set, see the Model check tab"`). Without the patient term, `r n_call("hmc, unpaired")` cell types are called.
- **T/NK subtypes, tumour vs its own normal tissue** (`r length(kept)` pairs; `r if (length(dropped)) paste(dropped, collapse = ", ") else "none"` left out with fewer than 30 T/NK cells in a sample): `r sig_txt`.
- Same direction in every pair: `r same_way_txt`.
- With `r length(kept)` pairs the paired Wilcoxon cannot go below p = `r sprintf("%.3f", floor_p)`, so a Wilcoxon p at that value means every pair moved the same way, not a large effect.

## Model check

Origin effect (primary vs non-malignant, log-odds scale with 95% credible interval) per cell type, for the report's pathfinder fit and two full-MCMC refits, with and without the patient term. Filled points: p < 0.05.

```{r model_check, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
ct |>
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("pathfinder, paired (report)", "hmc, paired", "hmc, unpaired")),
         cell_group = fct_reorder(cell_group, c_effect, .fun = mean), sig = c_pH0 < 0.05) |>
  ggplot(aes(c_effect, cell_group, colour = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = c_lower, xmax = c_upper), height = 0, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 2.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1), labels = c(`TRUE` = "p < 0.05", `FALSE` = "ns"), name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey40", "royalblue3", "darkorange2"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Primary vs non-malignant (log-odds)", y = NULL,
       title = sprintf("%d tumour + adjacent-normal pairs, all TME cell types", n_pairs)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(5.5, 15, 5.5, 5.5))
```

## T/NK subtypes {.tabset}

Share of each T/NK subtype among the T/NK cells of a sample, normal tissue vs primary tumour of the same patient. sccomp: `~ origin + (1 | Patient_nr)`, full MCMC. Cross-check: exact paired Wilcoxon on the shares (floor p = `r sprintf("%.3f", floor_p)`).

### Paired change

```{r tnk_forest, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 1.5 + 0.4 * nrow(tp)}
tp |>
  mutate(cell_group = fct_reorder(cell_group, c_effect),
         lab = sprintf("%s  p = %s", stars(c_pH0), fmt_p(c_pH0))) |>
  ggplot(aes(c_effect, cell_group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = c_lower, xmax = c_upper), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = c_effect > 0), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = max(c_upper) + 0.2, label = lab), hjust = 0, size = 3.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = unname(origin_colors["primary"]), `FALSE` = unname(origin_colors["non-malignant"])),
                      labels = c(`TRUE` = "higher in tumour", `FALSE` = "higher in normal"), name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(tp$c_lower), max(tp$c_upper) + 2), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Primary vs non-malignant (log-odds, 95% credible interval)", y = NULL,
       title = sprintf("T/NK subtypes, %d tumour-normal pairs (sccomp, paired)", length(kept))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(5.5, 20, 5.5, 5.5))
```

### Per patient

Lines join the two samples of a patient.

```{r tnk_per_patient, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 3.2 * ceiling(uniqueN(shares$SubTyping) / 4)}
facet_lab <- tp[, .(SubTyping = cell_group, lab = sprintf("%s\nsccomp p = %s, Wilcoxon p = %s", cell_group, fmt_p(c_pH0), fmt_p(wilcox_p)))]
merge(shares, facet_lab, by = "SubTyping") |>
  mutate(origin = factor(origin, levels = c("non-malignant", "primary")), lab = factor(lab, levels = facet_lab$lab)) |>
  ggplot(aes(origin, share)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Patient_nr), colour = "grey65") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = origin), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ lab, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = origin_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of T/NK cells") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) + theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9))
```

### Cells per sample

T/NK cells per sample; pairs with a sample below 30 T/NK cells are not tested.

```{r tnk_cells, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5}
n_tnk |>
  mutate(origin = factor(origin, levels = c("non-malignant", "primary"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(Patient_nr, N, fill = origin, alpha = kept)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = N), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = origin_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.35), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "T/NK cells (log scale)", title = "T/NK cells per sample in the tumour-normal pairs") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Methods

- **Data**: October 2026 TME object (149,062 cells, 63 samples), per-sample cell counts from its metadata. Pairs = patients with both a non-malignant and a primary sample (`r n_pairs`).
- **Cell types**: `majority_celltype`, all TME cell types, the same samples as the report's paired tab. Models: the report's fit (`sccomp_estimate(~ origin + (1 | Patient_nr))`, pathfinder), the same model with `inference_method = "hmc"`, and `~ origin` with hmc. All with `bimodal_mean_variability_association = TRUE`, `sccomp_remove_outliers`, then `sccomp_test`; p = sccomp `c_pH0`.
- **T/NK subtypes**: `SubTyping` levels of T and NK cells (CD4, CD8, MAIT, gdT, NK, proliferating T), composition within the T/NK cells only. Pairs kept when both samples have at least 30 T/NK cells; subtypes kept when seen in at least 3 kept samples. Same sccomp settings, hmc. Paired Wilcoxon: exact, two-sided, on the share of each subtype, unadjusted.
- sccomp `r packageVersion("sccomp")`. Script `04c_sccomp_paired_TNK.R`; tables in `Outputs/sccomp_paired_TNK_2026b/`.
